caption.en:
In Jeddah, "waterfront" is used for three completely different things:

• On the Corniche — a public view, public access, and traffic
• On a creek or marina — calm water, usually inside a compound
• A private beach — sand that belongs to the property or its community alone

The difference is not the view. It is privacy, maintenance, and who owns the sand.

Always ask: is the beach owned, a right of use, or shared?

في جدة، «واجهة بحرية» تُقال عن ثلاثة أشياء مختلفة تماماً:

• على الكورنيش — إطلالة عامة، وصول عام، وحركة

• شاطئ خاص — رمل يخصّ العقار أو المجمع وحده

الفرق بينها ليس في المنظر، بل في الخصوصية، والصيانة، ومن يملك الرمل.

اسأل دائماً: هل الشاطئ ملك، أم حق انتفاع، أم مشترك؟

caption.en:
In Jeddah, "waterfront" is used for three completely different things:

• On the Corniche — a public view, public access, and traffic
• On a creek or marina — calm water, usually inside a compound
• A private beach — sand that belongs to the property or its community alone

The difference is not the view. It is privacy, maintenance, and who owns the sand.

Always ask: is the beach owned, a right of use, or shared?

These words are used loosely in Jeddah, and the difference matters:

• Villa — a standalone building on its own plot, no shared walls
• Duplex — half a building, one shared wall, its own entrance

The practical question is not the name but: how many shared walls, and who owns what is between them?
